title: 第21章 强大的功能第22章 秘室
content_zh:
他开始测试了一下隐身的效果，凡是被他拿到身上的东西都能一起隐身。
而且，最神奇的是，在隐身的时候，他真的仿佛像是在其他的维度一样。
他甚至可以穿墙，穿进箱子里，从物体中穿过，只要他有意念穿过物体就能做到，身体还不受一点影响。
不过，这种情况下的话，应该要非常注意取消隐身时，身体就不能卡在物体中，否则他可能就会被卡死。
而取消隐身后，哪怕是没到达一个时辰的时间，再次开启时便会再消耗一点维点。
经过测试后，易长生心里不由得感叹了一下，这个隐身功能挺强大了，只要注意一点，别人想杀他都难啊！
这个隐身功能给他太多的安全感了，只要有维点在，他觉得自己死不了啊！
想了想，易长生又觉得不对，不能这么快就下结论，毕竟这里是修仙界。
他穿过的东西都是普通物体，要是修仙者有什么厉害的法术或是修仙界的灵物禁制阵法之类的，那就说不定了。
想着，他将之前买回来的锁灵盒拿出来试一下。
这个锁灵盒应该是修仙界的物品，而且看样子并不算是很高级的样子。
也不一定，易长生还没见识修仙界的东西，没有对比过，眼界有限，也不能确定这是不是个好东西。
现在易长生还处于隐身状态，他将手尝试着穿过盒子，没有意外真的会有阻力，手穿不过去。
他又试了一下看能不能打开盒子，可盒子仿佛是一个整体，可能盒子上还有修仙界的禁制手段在，所以根本就打不开。
之前易长生用全知视角就无法多维度观察盒子，只能隐隐的看到里面有一个空间的阴影，有没有东西都没能看清。
看来虚维之眼的等级还是太低了，只要将虚维之眼的等级提上去，应该就没有问题了吧。
还好今天收集到足够多的维点，可以先将虚维之眼提升到二级。
否则，易长生有点不怎么敢去凤鸣城，他怕修仙者会发现虚维之眼，也许低阶的修仙者可能发现不了，但高阶的修仙者那就很难说了。
想着，易长生没有犹豫，直接加点到虚维之眼之上，他加了95点，虚维之眼就升级了。
【虚维之眼lv.2（11000+）】

易长生看着升级lv.3的点数，居然这么多？
是前一级的十倍吧，这也太多了吧。
那以后虚维之眼的等级越高越难升啊！
他看了一眼二级虚维之眼的效果，全知视角一百米方圆，不管是天上还是地下都能看清，加上十米的模糊视角，就是一百一十米。
感觉一下子眼界开阔了很多啊！
如今他在地下室里，就直接看到上面宅院的情况，就连隔壁好几个宅院都能看清。
这么大的范围，能包括很多人了吧，收集维点应该也能快很多。
易长生看向锁灵盒，这次终于可以多维度，多切面的观察到盒子里了。
盒子里确实有东西，一块两指大的白玉，五张精美的符箓。
这些是什么符，易长生看不懂，那块玉也像是平平无奇的样子。
content_en:
He began to test the invisibility effect. Everything he got on his body could become invisible.
Moreover, the most amazing thing is that when he is invisible, he really seems to be in other dimensions.
He can even pass through walls, into boxes, and through objects. As long as he has the intention to pass through the objects, he can do it without affecting his body at all.
However, in this case, you should be very careful not to get stuck in the object when canceling the invisibility, otherwise he may be stuck.
After canceling the invisibility, even if it does not reach an hour, it will consume a few more dimension points when it is turned on again.
After the test, Yi Changsheng couldn't help but sigh in his heart. This invisibility function is quite powerful. As long as he pays attention, it will be difficult for others to kill him!
This invisibility function gave him too much sense of security. As long as Wei Point was there, he felt that he could not die!
After thinking about it, Yi Changsheng felt something was wrong. He couldn't draw conclusions so quickly. After all, this was the world of immortality.
The things he passed through were all ordinary objects. If the cultivator had any powerful spells or the spiritual object restriction formation in the world of cultivating immortals, then it might be possible.
Thinking about it, he took out the spirit lock box he bought before and tried it out.
This spirit lock box should be an item from the world of immortality, and it doesn't look very high-end.
Not necessarily, Yi Changsheng has not seen anything in the world of immortality, has not compared it, and has a limited vision, so he is not sure whether it is a good thing.
Now that Yi Changsheng was still invisible, he tried to put his hand through the box. No accident, there was really resistance and he couldn't get his hand through.
He tried again to see if he could open the box, but the box seemed to be a whole. Maybe there was a prohibition from the world of immortality on the box, so it couldn't be opened at all.
Previously, Yi Changsheng could not observe the box in multiple dimensions using his omniscient perspective. He could only vaguely see the shadow of a space inside, and could not see clearly whether there was anything there.
It seems that the level of the Eye of Virtual Dimension is still too low. As long as the level of the Eye of Virtual Dimension is raised, there should be no problem.
Fortunately, I collected enough dimension points today to upgrade the Eye of Virtual Dimension to Level 2 first.
Otherwise, Yi Changsheng is a little afraid to go to Fengming City. He is afraid that the immortal cultivators will find the Eye of Xuwei. Maybe the low-level immortal cultivators may not be able to find it, but it is hard to say for the high-level immortal cultivators.
Thinking about it, Yi Changsheng did not hesitate and directly added points to the Eye of Xuwei. He added 95 points, and the Eye of Xuwei was upgraded.
[Eye of Virtual Dimension lv.2 (11000+)]
Yi Changsheng looked at the points for upgrading to lv.3. There were actually so many?
It's probably ten times that of the previous level, which is too much.
Then the higher the level of the Eye of Virtual Dimension, the harder it will be to upgrade it!
He took a look at the effect of the second-level virtual eye. The omniscient viewing angle is one hundred meters in radius, and he can see clearly whether it is in the sky or underground. Adding the ten-meter blurred viewing angle, it is one hundred and ten meters.
I feel like my horizons have broadened a lot all of a sudden!
Now that he is in the basement, he can directly see the situation in the house above, and can even see clearly the several houses next door.
Such a large scope can include a lot of people, and collecting dimension points should be much faster.
Yi Changsheng looked at the spirit lock box. This time, he could finally observe the box from multiple dimensions and aspects.
There is indeed something in the box, a piece of white jade as big as two fingers and five exquisite talismans.
Yi Changsheng couldn't understand what kind of talismans these were, and the piece of jade seemed ordinary.
